headline: Higher Chance of Minimum Wage Increase; Huang Kuo-chang Criticizes Ministry of Labor for Post-Election "Make-Up Work" | Politics
summary: Taiwan's Ministry of Labor will convene its minimum wage review committee, and a rise may push next year's minimum wage above NT$30,000. Opposition party chairman Huang Kuo-chang criticized the timing as pre-election work.
why: Minimum wage changes affect labor costs for employers, particularly small businesses and retailers, and influence consumer spending power. The review committee sets the wage floor in Taiwan.
